title: Portugal - 2026.08.04
notes: Portugal is facing one of its most turbulent political and social moments in years, as the government pushes a sweeping overhaul of the labor code while unions mobilize mass strikes across public services. At the same time, the country's political center of gravity has shifted decisively to the right, with the far-right Chega party emerging as a pivotal parliamentary force. The combination of a fragile governing majority, escalating worker unrest, and rising populist influence is testing the resilience of Portuguese democratic institutions.
